verified_identity.title: Faster FPRAS for the Permanent via Restricted Poincaré Inequalities and Coupled Flows

primary_support.supports: Empirical-mean variance for block-constant observables; the stationary chain is finite, irreducible, reversible, and has nonnegative spectrum.
Restricted relaxation bounds for the permanent's hole-pattern partition.

released_source_support.evidence: The common-base manuscript explicitly credits CVY26 Definition 4 and Theorem 5(ii), with its Section 3.6, for this framework.

insertion.suggested_location: After the common-base proof-description paragraph, before the Chen–Liu comparison.
insertion.tex: Chen, Vigoda, and Yang already use partition-restricted Poincar\'e control to estimate hole-pattern frequencies for the permanent \cite[Definition~4 and Theorem~5(ii)]{FrontCVY2026}. The common-base manuscript explicitly adopts this empirical-average framework. Its candidate advance is the matroid-specific transport estimate and its compatibility with the transversal trace and warm-start construction, rather than the general observation that selected observables can be controlled without a full-chain gap.

scope_boundary: The prior treats the permanent; this reference alone does not provide an arbitrary-matroid common-base FPRAS.
